Independently converged with consistency-auditor's own NICE finding in the same Gate 4 parallel wave (same underlying shape, not an echo - neither agent saw the other's output).

adjudication_rationale: comment-only fix (0c6ba4e8): documents the closed-set invariant for the next maintainer touching reserve()'s reject_reason set. No structural guard added (would require reserve() to return an enum, out of scope for this PR).
